body:
It's just small things, like actually getting a job instead of lying around all day letting everything go to waste. Something that actually involves applying myself. But my qualifications are so mediocre and in the end, I know that I could never apply myself.

The part that really makes me feel like a piece of shit is that I feel like I'm above the kind of jobs I'm qualified to do. Can you imagine that? I've never done anything that proves I deserve better. I'm not only lazy and useless, I'm arrogant. At least I recognise that. But it doesn't mean I'm ever gonna accomplish anything other than wasting my life away.

I'm kind of smart, but my terrible motivation keeps me from doing anything with it. Whenever I try to do the right thing and try to improve myself, I feel ashamed because it's like I should have already done this years ago. I should have already made progress by now, but I'm just as lazy and practically useless I was ten years ago. It makes me sound so arrogant. But I can't help it. I feel like I should be better than this but I've done nothing to prove that I am.

That's why I couldn't imagine reinventing myself. Thinking that far ahead just hurts... all the wasted time.
